name: DunSocial
description:
DunSocial connects Claude to your social publishing workspace so you can create drafts, schedule posts, and publish approved content across X (Twitter), LinkedIn profiles and Business Pages, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, Reddit, Pinterest, and YouTube Shorts. TikTok publishing is available in limited beta.

Plan platform-specific content, schedule X threads, prepare Instagram images, carousels and Reels, publish Reddit posts and Pinterest Pins, and manage video content for supported destinations. Supported formats, media requirements, and account permissions vary by platform.

Review scheduled and published posts, reschedule or cancel queued content, manage reusable drafts and media assets, and access connected accounts and workspace details. Save and search brand memories, organize collections, and manage your workspace voice profile to help keep content consistent.

Connect securely with OAuth and choose the DunSocial workspace Claude can access. Users choose the content, destination accounts, and publishing time. Drafts stay unpublished until you choose to schedule or publish them. DunSocial does not provide social inbox, comment, or direct-message management.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DunSocial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DunSocial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.dunsocial.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DunSocial MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DunSocial lists 45 MCP tools, including cancel_post, complete_upload, create_collection, create_draft, delete_collection, delete_draft, delete_media, delete_memory, delete_post, get_draft, get_media, and get_personalization.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DunSocial?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DunSocial in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DunSocial requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DunSocial is developed by THISUX PRIVATE LIMITED. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
